entities.summary: Tal Friedman (b. 1963-12-20, Kiryat Ata) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Kiryat Ata and Israel. Known in the fields of israel, composers & musicians, asia.
